title: Lookbook Semanal de Moda de Estudiante Japonesa de Secundaria: Colección de 7 Outfits sobre Fondo Blanco
prompt: Create a fashion lookbook image showing seven identical Japanese high school girls with long black hair standing in a horizontal row. Each girl wears a different modest, modern casual outfit suitable for everyday wear by Japanese high school students. The image should maintain a clean, contemporary aesthetic. All seven figures are shown in full-body shots against a pure white or slightly ivory background, with natural shadows falling at their feet. The layout resembles a magazine cutout. Below each figure from left to right are the words Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. At the top is a stylish title text. The image uses studio lighting with high resolution in a 16:9 aspect ratio, presented in 4K quality.
